items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution via PHP code injection in the template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix, and the vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.id: Mirasvit Cache Warmer PHP Object Injection
items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension, which could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: CosmicSting attack & defense overview (aka CVE-2024-34102)
items.summary: CosmicSting is a critical XML external entity injection vulnerability in the REST API that allows an unauthenticated attacker to read arbitrary files, such as `env.php`, and can be chained with other bugs for remote code execution. Mass exploitation has been observed.
